scope: Tiny paired local contracts;root-owned runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Capture the actual runtime tuple
cases.input_contract: Record Spark, Scala binary and patch, JDK major and patch, Python version and optional PyArrow distribution version without installing anything.
cases.expected: Spark 4.0.1, Scala 2.13 family, JDK 17;actual patch strings and explicit not-installed Arrow when absent.
cases.verification: Inspect actual values and reject a claimed target qualification based only on a proposed version string.

cases.title: Run a type, NULL and multiplicity golden suite
cases.input_contract: Evaluate the supplied four-row bag plus exact decimal and timezone expressions.
cases.expected: 4 rows,3 known amounts, total 200,3 distinct IDs;decimal 12345678.90;instant 19:00UTC.
cases.verification: Compare exact metrics and rendered values under the UTC baseline.

cases.title: Preserve baseline state and reject incompatible reuse
cases.input_contract: Run the baseline ID-only deduplication query, then reject a request to change its state keys to id, cents while retaining that checkpoint.
cases.expected: Baseline output 1:100,2:200;preflight rejects changed keys before starting a new query.
cases.verification: Compare owned-query count before/after the refusal and confirm the old checkpoint/output remain present and unchanged.

cases.title: Run the changed query in a separate candidate namespace
cases.input_contract: Add a new occurrence 1:999 and run id, cents deduplication using a new checkpoint/output.
cases.expected: Candidate bag 1:100,1:999,2:200, which fails the baseline one-row-per-ID product gate.
cases.verification: Compare candidate and baseline exact bags and preserve old checkpoint/output.

cases.title: Rehearse rollback to the preserved compatible query
cases.input_contract: Resume the original ID-only query with its original checkpoint after the candidate is rejected.
cases.expected: The same baseline query ID resumes;the new occurrence of already-seen ID 1 does not add a row;baseline output stays 1:100,2:200.
cases.verification: Check query identity and exact sink bag without deleting either checkpoint.

cases.title: Gate a proposed runtime change on actual evidence
cases.input_contract: Require a qualified target profile, golden-suite pass, compatible recovery design and product acceptance before promotion.
cases.expected: The supplied unqualified target or failed candidate is rejected;all four true permits a proposal in this pure decision model.
cases.verification: Check missing-profile and wrong-product negatives, then record that no second runtime was provisioned.

golden.refusal_scope: application compatibility preflight,not fabricated Spark exception
